differences.openwhisper: In Settings > AI cleanup the agent tiles are always shown above the Cleanup model tile, and clicking a tile saves that agent, or the built-in model, at once.
differences.fiorivoce: The tiles appear after choosing Installed agent… in the provider dropdown, or while an agent is saved. A click only stages a tile; Apply runner commits it, and an agent is saved only after a confirmation that names it as the destination. Applying the built-in API / local model tile clears the approval, and a model picked for a staged agent is saved with Apply.
differences.reason: An installed agent receives the dictated words, so choosing one is confirmed for the named agent before anything is saved or sent.
differences.source: README.md, AI cleanup for dictation (the flow of commit 139a97b); src/ui_personalize/cleanup_model_section.cpp; tests/ui_personalize/test_cleanup_agent_choice.cpp and tests/ui_controller/test_agent_cleanup_consent.cpp

differences.openwhisper: Rule dictation ends each take with clear_recording_data(), which leaves one recording journal folder per rule dictation under the temporary folder.
differences.fiorivoce: Rule dictation ends each take with clear_recording_data(true), which discards the take's journal, so no folder is left behind.
differences.reason: A rule's spoken words are not a dictation to recover.
